key.name: last-chooser-folder
key.description: The URI of the folder that was last navigated to in the file chooser dialog.

key.name: chooser-view-mode
key.description: The active view style in the file chooser (grid, list, or compact).

key.name: chooser-sort-column
key.description: Column used to sort files in the file chooser (name, size, type, modified).

key.name: chooser-sort-ascending
key.description: Whether file sorting is in ascending order.

key.name: chooser-show-hidden
key.description: Whether to show hidden files and directories in the file chooser.
